$comment: An OVERRIDE file, not a theme: `extends` names the base whose complete token set this file inherits, and ONLY the keys that DIFFER live here. Anything absent is not a gap — it is the shesha value, resolved in memory by shesha-form-edit/scripts/compile/resolve-theme.mjs and validated as a COMPLETE theme against shesha-design-system/schemas/theme.schema.json before a single component is emitted. Duplicating a base value here is a defect: it re-introduces the drift inheritance exists to delete.
$source: LandBank Desktop Web design tokens (colors_and_type.css), sampled 1:1 from the Claude-designed Requirements Studio app
$description: Deep teal (#0d685a) is the interactive anchor and — unlike the Shesha default — it also COLOURS section headings (roles.sectionHeading resolves to brand, not ink). Warm accents (orange #f3a127 / #e28030) are logo + restricted-UI only. Type is Inter with a tighter line-height set and a larger 28px display step; cards carry a 12px radius. `statusLifecycle` is a REAL lifecycle (Shesha.RequirementsStudio.RsStatus), so its six named badges are the ones to map; the base's five generic tones remain resolvable underneath because badges merge additively.

accent.$use: logo + restricted UI (channel/CALL-CENTRE pill) only — never a general CTA colour

$deliveryLimits: TIER 4, brand-specific. Inherited from shesha unless listed here.

roles.navBg still resolves to the shesha palette.accent.navy (#000E8E) because this brand defines no navy of its own — the sidebar chrome is NOT branded teal. Add palette.accent.navy here to brand it; do not colour it from brand.primary by accident.

statusLifecycle.badges merges additively over the base, so the shesha generic tones (draft/success/warning/error/info) remain resolvable alongside the six RsStatus names. Map RsStatus items to the NAMED six; the lowercase five are the fallback vocabulary, not this lifecycle.

$antdTheme.$use: The resolved Ant Design 6.x ConfigProvider theme for the requirements-studio brand. Only the keys whose value DIFFERS from the shesha base live here; the rest is inherited. Each one was derived by PATH from this brand own tier-1 tokens (colorPrimary <- palette.brand.primary, Card.borderRadius <- radius.lg, ...), not by find-and-replace — see references/app-theme.md, and R-051 for how little of this block a 0.45 backend actually persists.
